datasetDifference: Scores 773 valid factual questions from 831 collected questions; 58 questions with defective reference information are excluded from quality scoring. source.title: Web Search retrieval evaluation: result lists, supplemental text and generated answers
source.method: Transcribed from the user-linked report, displayed artifact revision v16, overview tables and methodology. No evaluation was executed.
source.scope: L1 / facts: the values and 95% intervals displayed in artifact revision v16. The report identifies Webstone v0.6.0. Collection batches span October and November 2026.
source.dateNote: importedAt records transcription, not the date of a shared evaluation run. Report revisions and website result versions are independent.

notes: Layers are scored independently; L1, L2 and L3 scores are not added together.

Methods were collected in separate batches on different dates. Bocha AI Search used concurrency 4; the other methods used concurrency 1. Latencies are observed batch measurements, not a controlled same-window speed comparison.
L2 and L3 reuse the latency of the underlying API call rather than measuring a separate layer execution.
Quoted prices use different billing units: per request or per successful search. They are not realized total evaluation costs.
Confidence intervals are the 95% intervals printed in the report. A displayed leader is not a claim of statistical significance.

zh.Scores 773 valid factual questions from: 831 道已采集事实题中，58 道参考信息存在缺陷，质量评分排除这些题，采用 773 道有效题；延迟仍统计全部 831 次调用。来源匹配计入等价网址和已核验同页副本。尚未核实与固定数据集修订版本的逐条对应关系。
zh.Layers are scored independently; L1, L2: 各层独立评分，L1、L2、L3 分数不相加。
zh.Methods were collected in separate batch: 各方法在不同日期分批采集。博查 AI 搜索并发为 4，其他方法为 1。延迟是各自批次的观测值，并非同一时间窗口的受控速度对比。
zh.L2 and L3 reuse the latency of the under: L2 和 L3 沿用底层 API 调用耗时，不表示单独执行该层的时间。
zh.Quoted prices use different billing unit: 报价分别按请求或成功检索计费，不是本轮评测实际总成本。
zh.Confidence intervals are the 95% interva: 置信区间为报告列出的 95% 区间，榜首不等于具有统计显著性。
zh.Retains all collected calls, including f: 保留全部已采集调用，包括质量评分排除的事实题。各方法采集日期与并发不同。
